author: Filmento
description:
Mortal Kombat 2 continues 2021's Mortal Kombat by bringing in Johnny Cage. And boy does it get better. Seems like the filmmakers actually listened to audience feedback and tried to improve on those things. So let's dive into what they did and to what results.
